literal: Eleventh month, on dinghai day, made Southern Court Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaoyou Northern Chancellor, Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Renxian Southern Court great king, Northern Chancellor Xiao Ge associate Northern Court Privy Commissioner, yilibi affairs commissioner Yelü Xinxian Han mobile palace deployment director, Left yilibi Lü Fen tiyin, Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Dilie Left yilibi.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the eleventh month Southern Court Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaoyou was appointed Northern Chancellor; Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Renxian was made Southern Court great king; Northern Chancellor Xiao Ge was appointed associate Northern Court Privy Commissioner; yilibi affairs commissioner Yelü Xinxian was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Left yilibi Lü Fen was appointed tiyin; and Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Dilie was made Left yilibi.

literal: On jihai day, Bohai tribes universally registered troops and horses by Khitan household precedent.
idiomatic: On jihai day Bohai tribes had troops and horses registered throughout the realm following Khitan household rules.

literal: On yisi day, relief given to Nanjing poor.
idiomatic: On yisi day relief was granted to the poor of Nanjing.

literal: Twelfth month, on renshen day, partial amnesty for offenses at or below convict labor.
idiomatic: On renshen day of the twelfth month a partial amnesty was granted for offenses at or below convict labor.

literal: That day was Shengzong's birthday while he lived.
idiomatic: That day was Shengzong's birthday while he lived.
